messages:
tasha_csm: Heads-up — OxoHealth is running a live pilot demo on 2025-06-20 and requested a short uplift in eu-central. They want a temporary region pin to eu-central-1, allowlist one CIDR, and a per-route QPS boost for /v1/generate. This demo will influence their renewal (high opportunity). Can we fast-track?

quentin_support: Please paste org id, exact CIDR, desired uplift factor, and the window. Also confirm auto-revoke.

Oxo_OPS: Org id: org_oxo_42. CIDR: 150.222.10.5/32. Route: /v1/generate. Uplift: asking for 3x for 90 minutes. Window: 2025-06-20T13:00:00Z -> 2025-06-20T14:30:00Z. Auto-revoke: yes. Contact: ops@oxohealth.ai

maya_oncall: Plan: 1) add ACL for CIDR, 2) add region_pin eu-central-1 (allow fallback), 3) set per-route qps_override for org_oxo_42. Tagging @devin_eng for quick IP sign-off and concurrency guidance.

devin_eng: Quick check of 150.222.10.5 looks fine. Approve ACL and region pin. Recommendation: cap the uplift to 2.5x instead of 3x to avoid triggering aggressive autoscaling and noisy neighbor risk. Also set embeddings concurrency_cap=600 if they call embeddings later.

quentin_support: Got it. We'll do 2.5x and add the concurrency cap suggestion as a note. Staging command I'll run:

```bash
redwoodctl orgs patch-policy --org org_oxo_42 \\
  --patch '{"region_pin":"eu-central-1","routes":{"/v1/generate":{"qps_override":2.5}},"acls":["150.222.10.5/32"]}' \\
  --region eu-central-1 --expires 2025-06-20T14:30:00Z
```

quentin_support: I'll smoke in staging then push to prod. Will drop console link here.

deploy-bot: action=policy.patch start_time=2025-06-19T10:05:02Z actor=quentin_support status=queued

deploy-bot: action=policy.patch actor=quentin_support status=success time=2025-06-19T10:06:18Z ref=patch-94621

maya_oncall: Verified ACL + region pin + qps_override live in eu-central-1. Auto-revoke scheduled at 2025-06-20T14:30:00Z. I'll monitor p50/p95 and error rates during the window and flag anything anomalous.

Oxo_OPS: Warmup traffic looks good. Thanks for the quick turnaround. If demo converts, we'd like a follow-up on Dedicated capacity and SLA/pricing.

tasha_csm: Noted — I'll capture this in renewal tracker and schedule a technical follow-up next week if demo goes well. :sparkles:
